input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium portrait mobile slot-game main background, no UI
Primary request: an original soft and inviting champagne-gold pearl fortune lounge where the architecture subtly forms a five-reel slot machine
Scene/backdrop: elegant rounded art-deco arcade lounge, warm ivory and pale champagne walls, five softly lit reel bays integrated into a curved central pavilion, cascading pearl strings, playful stacks of blank gold coins, emeralds, rubies and diamonds placed naturally along the side shelves and lower corners, glossy cream-and-onyx floor
Style/medium: high-end polished 3D mobile game environment, friendly luxury, sophisticated but light, commercial game key art
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3; symmetric but relaxed; rounded curves rather than monumental columns; center softly darkened and uncluttered for readable UI and reel overlay; wealth elements frame the edges without crowding
Lighting/mood: diffused warm daylight mixed with soft marquee glow, gentle gemstone sparkles, controlled bloom, celebratory and welcoming, not solemn
Color palette: pale champagne gold, cream, pearl white, soft rose gold, caramel, small emerald and ruby accents; limited deep brown for contrast
Materials/textures: satin gold, nacreous pearl, velvet, polished gemstone, softly reflective lacquer
Constraints: five-reel slot structure must feel integrated and cohesive; many pearls, coins and gemstones; rounded elegant geometry; no characters; no text; no logo; no watermark; no currency symbols; no recognizable brand or IP
Avoid: royal palace, temple, cathedral, throne room, dark oppressive vault, harsh black-and-gold contrast, military grandeur, cheap yellow plastic, cluttered center, neon nightclub, flat vector art
